apps.name: P2Pme
apps.subtitle: Direct private photo backup & Wi-Fi sync
apps.localizedDescription:
P2Pme gives you complete ownership of your photos. Sync and back up camera roll photos directly to your Android server or PC with zero cloud intermediaries.

• Continuous automated photo backup
• End-to-end encrypted direct Wi-Fi and WebRTC transfer
• Zero cloud storage, 100% private

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: P2Pme needs access to your photos to automatically back up your camera roll to your home server.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: P2Pme needs permission to save received photos and videos to your photo library.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: P2Pme discovers and transfers with your 24/7 home server and nearby peers directly over Wi-Fi.
